data.title: Legacy earmarked levies (NASENI 0.25%, Police Trust Fund 0.005%) — pre-2026, superseded by the 4% Development Levy

provenance.as_passed: NASENI Act (0.25% levy on profit before tax); Nigeria Police Trust Fund (Establishment) Act 2019 (0.005% of net profit); NTA 2025 s.59 (consolidation into Development Levy from 2026)
provenance.source_citation: NASENI Act; Nigeria Police Trust Fund (Establishment) Act 2019 s.4; NTA 2025 s.59; PwC Nigeria corporate tax summaries
